subject: SCIM delta & role ownership: evidence pack request (SOC 2 intake)
messages:
From: Alan Phelps <alan.phelps@commerchealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: CommerceHealth Security <security@commerchealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM delta, role owners, and delegated service accounts

Hi Vanessa,

As part of our SOC 2 readiness intake, Security is collecting artifacts to validate provisioning and least-privilege practices for vendors. We reviewed your SIG and have a few live asks we need to validate before next Tuesday's audit window: 

1) SCIM delta extract covering the last 90 days (create/update/deactivate events) for the CommerceHealth tenant — CSV preferred, with timestamp and user id / externalId mapping.
2) Role ownership snapshot (who is assigned each role in the tenant) as of 2026-06-30.
3) Samples of SAML assertion logs for two recent successful logins for accounts in our tenant (redact PII but include NameID and attributes).
4) A short narrative describing delegated admin/service account usage — which service accounts are allowed to create users via SCIM or bypass normal approval flows.

We need the files and a mapped README describing column semantics and any transformations you performed. Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Ideally by COB Friday 2026-08-06.

Thanks,
Alan
Alan Phelps
Senior Security Engineer, CommerceHealth
alan.phelps@commerchealth.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Phelps <alan.phelps@commerchealth.com>
Cc: CommerceHealth Security <security@commerchealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta, role owners, and delegated service accounts

Thanks Alan — we can provide all of the artifacts you listed. Quick notes and clarifying Qs so we deliver exactly what you need: 

- SCIM delta: we'll export a CSV with event_type, timestamp (UTC), actor_user_id, target_user_external_id, attribute_changes. Will include a short README describing column names.
- Role ownership snapshot: we will produce an export mapping role_id, role_name, assigned_principal_type (user/service_account), principal_identifier, assignment_date.
- SAML samples: we can extract assertion logs; they contain NameID and attribute statements. We'll redact email addresses per your guidance but will preserve NameID (hashed) and attribute keys.
- Delegated admin/service accounts: we'll attach a one-page summary listing service accounts with elevated SCIM write permissions and the guardrails applied (IP restrictions, rotation cadence, owner).

ETA: initial bundle by EOD Thu 2026-08-06. If you need it sooner we can prioritize — let me know.

Attachments we'll include: scim_delta_202606-202608.csv (trimmed), role_ownership_snapshot_2026-06-30.csv, saml_assertion_sample-2026-06-30.txt, delegation_summary.md.

Jonas — tagging you to confirm the snapshot names and that the SAML extraction will be non-PII.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta, role owners, and delegated service accounts

Vanessa — I can assemble the exports. A few implementation details: 

- SCIM delta is generated by our provisioning audit job; it captures create/update/deactivate events and includes scim.patch payload diff. We'll include UTC timestamps and externalId mapping. File name: scim_delta_202606-202608.csv (will include header row).
- Role ownership snapshot: we'll include a column principal_kind (user/service_account) and a reference to the internal owner (team alias). We maintain binding history — if CommerceHealth wants change history beyond the snapshot, we can add a separate CSV.
- SAML assertions: we will redact email addresses but include NameID hashed (sha256) and attribute keys. Note: full raw assertions live in our secure logs; extraction will be sanitized and provided as saml_assertion_sample-2026-06-30.txt.
- Delegation summary: there are two service accounts with SCIM write scope (svc-scim-sync and svc-provisioner). Both have key rotation every 90 days and are restricted to Redwood-managed IP ranges with scoped roles. Owner teams are listed in the delegation_summary.md.

I will drop the files into the secure Drive folder and attach the Drive links in the reply. Marissa — please confirm the role_ownership snapshot export format matches SOC 2 auditor expectations (role, principal, assignment_date, source).

-Jonas

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Phelps <alan.phelps@commerchealth.com>

Alan — attaching the sanitized bundle here and linking to the secure Drive location. Included in the zip: scim_delta_202606-202608.csv, role_ownership_snapshot_2026-06-30.csv, saml_assertion_sample-2026-06-30.txt, delegation_summary.md. 

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/secure/CH-SOC2/SCIM-DELTA-2026 (access granted to your security team).
DocuSign link for our evidence transfer acknowledgement: https://docusign.com/redirect/envelope/0a1b2c3d4e

Quick highlights for your auditors: 
- SCIM export includes event_type, timestamp_utc, actor_user_id (redwood internal id), target_external_id (your user id), attributes_changed.
- Role snapshot contains principal_kind, principal_identifier (type/id), role_name, role_id, assignment_date, and owner_team.
- SAML samples are masked: NameID hashed, attributes listed (role, department, auth_time). No PII included.
- Delegated service accounts: svc-scim-sync, svc-provisioner — both have rotation and IP restrictions; owners listed in delegation_summary.md.

If your auditor needs a short write-up describing how we validate least-privilege in our provisioning pipeline, we can add a one-page control narrative by tomorrow. Please confirm receipt and let us know if anything needs re-sanitizing.
